question: How many medals did India win in total at the World Para Athletics Grand Prix 2025?
solution:
The correct answer is __**134**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__

__
 
• India secured a total of **134 medals** at the World Para Athletics Grand Prix 2025, marking a significant achievement for Indian para-athletes.
 
• The medal tally comprised **gold, silver, and bronze medals** across various events, showcasing India's growing strength in para-athletics.
 
• The Grand Prix is one of the most prestigious events in **para-athletics worldwide**, providing a platform for differently-abled athletes to demonstrate their abilities.
 
• India's performance at the event highlights the success of government initiatives aimed at supporting para-athletes, including dedicated training programs and financial assistance.
 
• Indian para-athletes continue to make strides on the global stage, contributing to the nation's reputation in international sports.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Para-athletics:**

 
 
• It is a branch of athletics specifically designed for athletes with physical disabilities.
 
• Events include track and field disciplines such as running, jumping, and throwing.
 
• Competitions are classified based on the type and degree of disability to ensure fair participation.
 
 
 
• **World Para Athletics Grand Prix:**
 
 
• An annual global event organized by **World Para Athletics**, a division of the International Paralympic Committee (IPC).
 
• It serves as a qualifying event for the Paralympic Games and other major championships.
 
• The Grand Prix attracts elite para-athletes from around the world, offering high-level competition.
 
 
 
• **Indian Government Support:**
 
 
• The Indian government provides financial assistance and training facilities for para-athletes under schemes like **Target Olympic Podium Scheme (TOPS)**.
 
• Specialized coaching and access to advanced equipment are made available to enhance performance.
 
• Recognition and awards are also granted to outstanding athletes to encourage participation.
 
 
 
• **India's Growth in Para-sports:**
 
 
• India has seen a steady rise in the number of medals won in international para-sports events over the years.
 
• Initiatives such as state-level para-athletics meets and talent identification programs have contributed to this growth.
 
• Efforts are being made to increase awareness and inclusivity for differently-abled athletes across the country.
